issue_context.title: binary_sensor.updater unavailable most of the time
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The binary_sensor.updater is unavailable most of the time.

Going to https://updater.home-assistant.io gives {"release-notes":"https://www.home-assistant.io/latest-release-notes/","version":"2021.4.6"}

Pretty sure I'm on 2021.8.8 so im a little unsure why  https://updater.home-assistant.io seems to be stuck on 2021.4.6

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.8.8

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

Home Assistant OS

comments:
`updater.home-assistant.io` is no longer used
<https://www.home-assistant.io/version.json> is used for this integration.

And from the looks of it, it behaves correctly, it reached a timeout, and logged that.
When there is an issue with fetching the data (for any entity), the state should become "unavailable"

This integration even has a timeout value of 30 which is 5 times more than most other integrations (5)
<https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/homeassistant/components/updater/__init__.py#L128>

My guess is that:
a) You have network issues in your setup (Try disable IPv6 in the supervisor panel)
b) You are blocking that URL

Hey there @home-assistant/core, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`updater`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L550) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>
I'm having the same issue for a short time now, the updater sensor being unavailable most of the time.

@ludeeus don't know that just happened, but it randomly fixed it self. it was reoprting an available update just after reboot and then becoming unavailable for some time now (even though im up to date). But now, without me doing anything, ist available now and after me manually calling update entity, it also shows im up to date after showing there is an update before. Weird.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/38779449/131835969-72560166-604c-4ad3-93a1-e8bdef0970b4.png)

I don't get it but it seems fine now.

EDIT: I've figured it out. When i manually update the entity, it shows up to date for a few minutes (2-3), after that, it goes unavailable. if i then update it again it shows up to date again. so it seems some problem with homeassistant thinking it's unavailable but it isn't?
That really sounds like network issues, it checks on startup, and every 24h after that

> That really sounds like network issues, it checks on startup, and every 24h after that

Don't think so because as mentioned in the edit, manually updating the entity seems to work everytime. and if the automatic update onlyx happens every 24h network problems should not be the reason for it becoming unavailable again after a few minutes. (multiple times in a row)

review_comments: Is the problem that we schedule the first coordinator refresh and then load the platform with the entity? So the entity may not receive an update until after 24 hours after start.
